detailed_description: BMI Calculator helps you calculate your Body Mass Index, a widely used measure of body fat based on height and weight. This tool supports both metric (kg/cm) and imperial (lbs/in) units, making it accessible for users worldwide. Get instant health classification and see where you fall on the BMI scale.
usage_steps: Select your preferred unit system (metric or imperial)
Check the healthy weight range for your height
usage_examples: Check if your weight is in the healthy range
Track BMI changes during a fitness program
Understand BMI categories and health implications
